children: Crypto investors are moving into altcoins and away from Bitcoin
as markets prepare for a potentially tougher U.S. interest-rate backdrop, according to new data from CoinMarketCap.

In a recent note shared with Cryptoprowl, Alice Liu, Head of Research at CoinMarketCap, said the platform’s Altcoin Season Index climbed 59% in the past week, rising from 27 to 43. “Capital isn't leaving crypto, it's rotating out of Bitcoin into everything else,” she said.

Speculative trading is driving the market rotation. CoinMarketCap ranked the roughly $1 billion Four.Meme ecosystem, a memecoin launchpad and trading platform built on the BNB Chain, as the second-most popular market narrative, behind the $2.06 trillion U.S. Strategic Crypto Reserve.
Four.Meme’s market capitalization has risen 15.7% over the past week, while its volume-weighted performance was 65.5% higher than the broader crypto market over the past 24 hours.

Individual tokens show just how aggressive the trading has become. Chinese-language BSC meme token 哈基米, for example, reached about $60.6 million in market capitalization while recording $60.5 million in 24-hour volume, despite having only about $4 million in liquidity.
“Right now CoinMarketCap's Community trending board has Chinese-language memecoins, tokenized Nvidia
, and tickers named after AI labs sitting side by side, one of them up 262% in a day. Retail attention has stopped distinguishing between crypto assets and everything else,” Alice wrote.

Last week, U.S. net dollar liquidity fell 0.19%, while the two-year Treasury yield proxy stood at 4.34%, well above the 3.63% policy anchor. CoinMarketCap classified the market regime as “headwind tightening.”

Bitcoin is currently trading at around $79,600, largely flat over the past day, while the total crypto market stands at $2.71 trillion. CoinMarketCap’s prediction-market data put the odds of Bitcoin closing above $80,000 on Tuesday at 43.5%.

title: Crypto Investors Rotate From Bitcoin Into Altcoins as Rate Risks Rise
